items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section III, List of Answers on Topics 89:1
items.html: They are all included in the five Partzufim of AK, for AK is reckoned as the first ten Sefirot that emerged at the head of the line after the restriction. (Etz Chaim, Gate 3, Chapter 1)
